# Detail book

## Crafts

### Reed Weaving
```o2t-details
pace: Brisk
kind: craft
needs: "[[#Basket Knots|Basket Knots]]"
starter: true
```
You weave reeds into mats, baskets and rope. A fresh reed bends without
breaking; a dry one snaps.
